Title: Azure Private Link support in Azure Data Factory now available

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory (ADF) now supports Azure Private Link. With Azure Private Link in ADF, customers can interact with ADF service as a private endpoint in their Virtual Network, ensuring that management operations are completely isolated. Traffic between customer's Virtual Network and ADF goes through Azure Private Link which provides private connectivity between the two. It simplifies the network architecture and secures the connection between endpoints in Azure by eliminating data exposure to the public internet.

Learn more
